text: Measured by the brain on this machine (4 cores, 2026-10-25): cold compile of all tests (cargo test --no-run) 67 s; running the suite with a warm build 673 s. So running dominates, not compiling. cargo test runs test binaries one at a time; the slowest are athena-cli tests/lifecycle.rs 174 s, tests/job_plan.rs 83 s, tests/drain.rs 61 s, athena-core unit tests 61 s, tests/retry.rs 54 s, tests/steward.rs 48 s, tests/introspection.rs 36 s. Prefer cargo-nextest (buy-first), pinned by version and checksum like the other tools in athena.toml [tools], which runs individual tests in parallel across binaries; run doctests separately with cargo test --doc so every test still runs. Use it for Athena's test check, CI and the producer's guidance. Put these measured numbers in the decision entry as measured by the brain; if nextest cannot be installed in the sandbox, say so and fall back to splitting the slowest binaries' tests to run in parallel.
